source: Arks of Omen: Grand Tournament (January 2023), Warlord Trait Requisition Stratagem (1 CP): a Warlord only gets a Warlord Trait if you use it, and a named character with listed traits gets them for that 1 CP (research library 01_Core_Rules/Army_Building_Detachments_and_CP.md §5, §6). Codex: Imperial Knights (2022), Knight Lances: each Super-heavy detachment (or the single Super-heavy Auxiliary in Combat Patrol) nominates one Armiger, Questoris or Dominus Knight as a CHARACTER (research library 03_Codexes/Imperium/Imperial_Knights.md §2). BSData v9.8.0 limits Character (Knight Lance) to 1 per roster; the limit is 1 per detachment, so the scope becomes force.

Wahapedia datasheet 000000854 (Onager Dunecrawler) wargear options: "This model can be equipped with one of the following: broad spectrum data-tether; smoke launchers." The choice is optional; BSData v9.8.0 makes the Onager Dunecrawler's Wargear group compulsory (min 1), so every Onager without one reported option-required. The minimum becomes 0 (the max of 1 stays).

overrides/must-be-warlord.json (Abaddon the Despoiler): the policy checks that Abaddon the Despoiler is the Warlord, or that another unit with a rule to that effect is (Daemon Primarch, The Warmaster and similar: "If more than one model in your army has a rule to this effect, then one of those models must be your army's WARLORD"). BSData v9.8.0 makes Abaddon's Warlord compulsory (min 1 on link feae-8926-f679-9e2f), so Abaddon the Despoiler beside another such unit could not be built legally (e.g. Mortarion with Abaddon or Magnus); the minimum stays 0 and the player turns "Warlord" on.
